acceptance_checks: Add an end-to-end regression test that loads `ignore-paths = ["^src/gen/.*$"]` from project configuration and runs recursive linting on `src/`.
Verify the regression test proves files under `src/gen/` are absent from the linted paths.
Verify the regression test proves at least one non-ignored file under `src/` remains linted.
Cover the approved behavior for both POSIX and Windows path forms.
Run and preserve all existing recursive-ignore tests.
Verify `ignore`, `ignore-patterns`, configuration precedence, and non-recursive behavior remain unchanged.
confirmed_decisions: Recursive ignore-path matching uses paths relative to the invocation/config project directory, not paths relative to each recursive target or raw absolute walked paths.
Recursive discovery uses the same initialization-time captured ignore-path configuration as normal module expansion.
The implementation may choose the internal path-normalization or refactoring approach.
Do not change `ignore`, `ignore-patterns`, configuration precedence, or non-recursive semantics.
The intentional compatibility change is limited to previously unspecified recursive behavior for anchored ignore-path expressions, which will use the approved project-relative basis.
summary: Fix recursive ignore-path handling so recursive discovery uses the initialization-time captured ignore-path patterns and evaluates them against project-relative paths in both POSIX and Windows forms. With project configuration `ignore-paths = ["^src/gen/.*$"]`, running `pylint --recursive=y src/` must exclude `src/gen/` and its Python files. Scope is limited to recursive ignore-path handling and regression coverage.
